Q. 視聴履歴や作品検索が使えません: Q. Watch history and work search are unavailable
視聴履歴の表示・更新と作品検索には Annict との連携が必要です。サインイン: Viewing and updating your watch history and searching for works require connecting to Annict. After signing in, connect your Annict account from the "Annict integration" card on the Profile tab.
QR タブの「マイQR」に表示されるコードを相手の「スキャン」で読み取ると名刺を: You can exchange cards by having the other person scan the code shown under "My QR code" on the QR tab with their "Scan". Signing in is required to display your QR code.
Q. dアニメストアの視聴履歴を取り込めません: Q. I can't import my d Anime Store watch history
Watch history import is only available on the web version (https://animeishi.uomi.dev). After signing in on the web, open the import screen from "Import from d Anime Store" on the watch history screen and follow the instructions to add the bookmarklet to your browser's bookmarks bar. Run the bookmark while logged in on the d Anime Store watch history page and the extraction results are transferred automatically. If the transfer fails, the results are copied to your clipboard — paste them into the field on the import screen to continue. Imported works are reflected in your Annict watch status.
Q. アカウントやデータを削除したいです: Q. I want to delete my account and data
サインイン後、プロフィール画面の「アカウントを削除」から削除できます。名刺・視聴: After signing in, you can delete your account from "Delete account" on the Profile screen. All data — cards, watch history, oshi, friends, tier lists, and more — will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.
